entries.title: OFC 2027
format: Contributed papers: 35-word abstract and a three-page summary in PDF.
Include title, authors and affiliations, the abstract, and the required copyright statement.
Use the official meeting style guide; separate tracks have their own instructions.
entries.note: The author timeline lists dates only. Check the submission portal for the closing time and timezone.
entries.fit: Optical communication, PIC devices, optical interconnects and systems.

entries.title: CLEO 2027
format: 35-word abstract and a two-page summary, submitted as a PDF.
Include title, authors, affiliations and the required copyright statement; embed all fonts.
Use the official CLEO style guide and confirm the 2027 two-page limit.
entries.fit: Integrated photonics, lasers, optical devices and quantum optics.

entries.title: IEEE SiPhotonics 2027
format: 2-page paper, including figures; single-spaced; 1-inch margins.
45-word abstract and 50-word presenter biography.
entries.fit: Silicon photonic devices, integration, fabrication and applications.

entries.title: IEEE IPC 2026
format: 2-page paper including figures; single-spaced; 1-inch margins.
45-word abstract. Recheck next-cycle template.
entries.note: May forecast uses the Society’s regular-call extension announcement. Later extensions do not establish a next-year deadline.
entries.fit: Photonics devices, optical communications, computing and quantum photonics.

entries.title: OIP 2026
format: 2-page IEEE paper including authors and figures.
Abstract of at most 45 words.
entries.note: 2027 meeting moves from June to April; the previous April submission month is only a weak planning estimate. Start checking earlier.
entries.fit: Optical Interconnects and Packaging: CPO, chiplets, photonic devices and design.

entries.title: NUSOD 2026
format: 2-page abstract using the IEEE template.
entries.note: Original CFP: March 13; organizer announced a final extension to March 27. The 2027 meeting moves to September; the March forecast may shift.
entries.fit: Numerical simulation, compact models, inverse design and optoelectronic devices.

entries.title: Photonics West 2027
format: Submit an abstract to the relevant OPTO conference; requirements vary by conference.
Use the linked SPIE presenter instructions for the abstract and later proceedings manuscript.
entries.note: The later proceedings manuscript deadline is not the entry deadline for a new submission.
entries.fit: OPTO tracks on silicon photonics, photonic integration, lasers and optical interconnects.

entries.title: ICCAD 2026
format: Use the IEEE/ACM regular-paper template and anonymization rules in the full CFP.
Abstract registration is a mandatory earlier gate.
entries.fit: CAD methods, modeling, physical design and emerging technologies; CFP explicitly includes nanophotonics.

entries.title: ASP-DAC 2027
format: 6 pages + 1 references-only page; two columns; PDF.
Double-blind submission. Abstract registration precedes the PDF deadline.
entries.fit: Track 6: Photonic/RF/Analog-Mixed Signal Design; includes communication and computing using photonics.

event.venue: Hitotsubashi Hall, National Center of Sciences Building

entries.title: DATE 2027
format: 6 pages + 1 references-only page; two columns; minimum 10 pt.
Double-blind; no author names or affiliations in the submission.
entries.fit: Design Methods and Tools, on-chip communication and emerging technologies. Fit requires a design/automation contribution; a dedicated photonics track is not confirmed.

entries.title: DAC 2027
format: Research track: 6 pages + 1 references-only page; two columns; IEEE template.
Abstract registration is required before manuscript upload.
entries.note: Full-paper date conflict: the research-page timeline says Nov 18, 2026 (17:00 PST), while its FAQ and event listings say Nov 17. Verify the submission portal; this page uses the earlier mandatory abstract gate, Nov 11.
entries.fit: EDA, emerging interconnects, chiplets and electronic–photonic co-design; select a matching research category.

entries.title: IEEE IPC 2026 · Post-deadline
format: 2-page paper including figures; single-spaced; 1-inch margins.
45-word abstract.
entries.note: For new, significant late-breaking results; this is a separate reviewed research call, not an extension of regular submissions.
entries.fit: Photonics devices, optical communications, computing and quantum photonics.

eligibility.basis: The open call invites authors to submit new and significant results; it lists no degree or career-stage restriction. Student authors are eligible under these published rules.

entries.title: OFC 2027 · Post-deadline
format: Contributed papers: 35-word abstract and a three-page summary in PDF.
Include title, authors and affiliations, the abstract, and the required copyright statement.
Use the official meeting style guide; separate tracks have their own instructions.
entries.note: For new, significant late-breaking results; this is a separate reviewed research call, not an extension of regular submissions.
entries.fit: Optical communication, PIC devices, optical interconnects and systems.

eligibility.basis: Technical submissions are open to all members of the scientific and technical community, and postdeadline papers use the contributed-submission process. Student authors are eligible; postdeadline papers are excluded from the student-paper competition.

entries.title: Advances in High-Speed Intensity Modulation and Direct Detection Technologies
format: Use JSTQE author instructions; select the named special-issue manuscript type.
Graphical abstract encouraged.
entries.note: Issue publication: Jan–Feb 2027. This call is not assumed to recur annually.
entries.fit: High-speed IM/DD links, PIC/EIC devices, packaging and systems.

entries.title: Emerging Photonic Computing
format: Use JSTQE author instructions; select “Special Issue on Emerging Photonic Computing”.
Graphical abstract strongly suggested.
entries.note: Issue publication: May–Jun 2027 (tentative). This call is not assumed to recur annually.
entries.fit: Integrated photonic computing, accelerators, neuromorphic systems and electronic–photonic platforms.

entries.title: Numerical Simulation of Optoelectronic Devices
format: Select the named special issue and technical topic “06 – Focus Issue”.
Original papers are welcome even if not presented at NUSOD 2026.
entries.note: Issue publication: Spring 2027 (tentative). This call is not assumed to recur annually.
entries.fit: Device/PIC modeling, inverse design, multiphysics and reproducible simulation.

entries.title: Topologic Photonics and Structured Light
format: Use JSTQE author instructions and the TPSL2027 special-issue manuscript type.
entries.note: Issue publication: Nov–Dec 2027. This call is not assumed to recur annually.
entries.fit: Topological photonics, structured light and classical/quantum photonic devices.

entries.title: Semiconductor Lasers
format: Use the live JSTQE author instructions; the CFP PDF still contains placeholder submission URLs.
Submissions open October 1, 2026.
entries.note: Issue publication: Jan–Feb 2028 (tentative). This call is not assumed to recur annually.
entries.fit: Integrated semiconductor lasers, low-noise sources and co-packaged optics.

entries.title: Journal of Lightwave Technology
format: Use the standard two-column, single-spaced journal format.
Place figures within the text for an accurate page count. Use the journal’s current author instructions and template.
